xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4210: Deferred work-agent handoffs are lost on dashboard restart (retry timers live only in memory)

plan.title: Deferred work-agent handoffs are lost on dashboard restart (retry timers live only in memory)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Guardrail-deferred planning hand-offs for PAN-4197..4201 were never retried. The issue blames in-memory timers, but PAN-4155 already keeps the schedule in the pipeline journal and re-reads it on every deacon-lite tick, including at boot. Verified causes: (1) deacon.globally_paused has been 'true' in overdeck.db since 2026-09-18T11:11Z, so runDeaconLite() returns before retryDeferredHandoffs runs; (2) even unfrozen, operatorStandDownReason would abandon every deferral as 'planning was restarted' because the planning agent's state.json status label stays 'running' forever (post-PAN-3917 saveAgentStateAndEmitEvent writes no state.json). Deferral messages also promise a two-hour retry that the freeze silently prevents.
narratives.Proposal: Make the stand-down read facts (live inventory, paused, startedAt/stoppedAt) instead of status labels. Prove boot-time re-derivation and freeze hold/resume with a startDeaconLite()-level test on the incident's exact shape. Keep honoring the Deacon freeze as the operator's emergency stop, but record deaconPaused in the deferral journal entry and say the retry is held in activity, the complete-planning response, pan plan finalize/done output, and pan show. Document the rules in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Exempting retryDeferredHandoffs from the Deacon freeze
- Pausing or extending the two-hour retry window while the Deacon is frozen
- Making the planning stop projection write state.json, or fixing status-label staleness outside deferred-handoff.ts
- Detecting remote (Fly) work agents in the stand-down beyond the AGENT_START_IN_FLIGHT refusal
- Changing guardrail acknowledgement on the first attempt or on retries
- Flipping deacon.globally_paused or cloister.spawns_paused on any machine
- Removing the dead CloisterService.isSpawnPaused() or the cloister.spawns_paused flag
- Adding any new stored status for hand-offs

autoDecisions.summary: Plan the verified causes (Deacon freeze + stale planning status label) instead of the issue's in-memory-timer hypothesis
autoDecisions.rationale: The retry schedule is already journal-backed and re-derived on every tick including boot (deferred-handoff.ts header; existing test 'resumes the schedule from the journal after a restart'). Implementing the literal ask would ship nothing. This is a wrong diagnosis, not a contradiction between authoritative inputs, so auto-planning proceeds.

autoDecisions.summary: The deferred-handoff retry keeps honoring the Deacon freeze; the hold is made visible instead
autoDecisions.rationale: The freeze is the operator's emergency stop (Snowflake toggle + banner); an automated spawn must not bypass it. Alternative for the operator to flip: move retryDeferredHandoffs out from under the isDeaconGloballyPaused() early return, since consent was granted and guardrails still apply on retry.

autoDecisions.summary: The two-hour retry window keeps counting while frozen
autoDecisions.rationale: On unfreeze an older deferral gives up with planning.failed and a warn line naming pan start, which is already loud and actionable; freeze-aware clock math adds stored state for little value.

autoDecisions.summary: Drop status-label checks from operatorStandDownReason for both planning and work agents
autoDecisions.rationale: state.json status is a spawn-time snapshot; agent state is written only after the pane exists, so a live agent is in the inventory or has startedAt later than the deferral. Keeping the label check makes every deferral stand down.

autoDecisions.summary: Surface the hold via a response field workAgentRetryHeld: 'deacon-paused' rather than having the CLI read the flag itself
autoDecisions.rationale: The server decides once at deferral time and the CLI renders it, keeping one source for the message.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In operatorStandDownReason (src/lib/cloister/deferred-handoff.ts, search `function operatorStandDownReason`): delete the line `if (work.status === 'running' || work.status === 'starting') return 'a work agent already exists';` and change the planning condition to `if (planning && after(planning.startedAt))`. Keep the liveAgentIds check, the paused check, and the startedAt/stoppedAt checks. Add a one-line comment: the status label is a spawn-time snapshot because complete-planning's stop projection writes no state.json. In the existing test file add: (a) 'retries when the planning label still reads running from before the deferral' (planning state {status:'running', startedAt: T0-30min}; after tick(2) spawn called once, last handoff entry handoff.retried); (b) 'retries when a work label reads running with no live pane and an older start' (work state {status:'running', startedAt: T0-60min}; after tick(2) spawn called once); (c) a new it.each stand-down row 'a planning session restarted after the deferral' (planning {status:'running', startedAt: T0+1min}). Use the file's existing fake timers and tick helper. Also (PRD WI-1, FR-2a): in classifySpawnSkip (src/lib/cloister/work-agent-start.ts:16-26) add `if (body['code'] === 'AGENT_START_IN_FLIGHT') return 'already-running';` before the 409 guardrails line, and add 'already-running' to STAND_DOWN_SKIP_REASONS in deferred-handoff.ts. Add a fetch-stub test next to 're-sends the spawn with no guardrail acknowledgement': fetch answers 409 { error: 'Agent agent-pan-4155 is already starting or running.', code: 'AGENT_START_IN_FLIGHT' }; after the due retry the last handoff entry is handoff.abandoned with outcome 'stood-down'.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. (1) recordHandoffDeferred in src/lib/cloister/deferred-handoff.ts gains optional deaconPaused?: boolean; when true the journal data gets deaconPaused: true (schedule fields unchanged). (2) recordPlanningAutoHandoffDeferred (src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts:370) gains optional readDeaconPaused?: () => boolean, defaulting to a try/catch wrapper around isDeaconGloballyPaused() (from ./control-settings.js) that returns false on error; passes it to recordHandoffDeferred; return type becomes { error: string; deaconPaused: boolean }; update the single caller at planning-promotion.ts:864. (3) When paused, the warn activity message is `${issueId} planning complete; work-agent start deferred by spawn guardrails. The retry is held while the Deacon is frozen: unfreeze it, or run pan start ${issueId}. ${error}`; otherwise unchanged. (4) Response: when autoHandoffDeferred and deaconPaused, add workAgentRetryHeld: 'deacon-paused' and message `Planning complete; work-agent start deferred by spawn guardrails and held while the Deacon is frozen (unfreeze it or run pan start ${id}): ${error}`; otherwise unchanged. (5) Replace the stale comment paragraph starting 'Routed through the canonical transactional write door' (planning-promotion.ts:774-796) with: the projection appends an agent.status_changed event via saveAgentStateAndEmitEvent and writes no state.json, so the planning agent's status label keeps its spawn-time value. (6) If planning-promotion.ts grows past its origin/main line count, replace its row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt with `<lines> src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts # PAN-4210` in the same commit. Tests: update 'journals a guardrail-deferred handoff for deacon-lite and records no planning failure' for the new return shape with readDeaconPaused: () => false; add 'journals a frozen-Deacon hold and says the retry is held' with readDeaconPaused: () => true.
